== Biography ==
'''Euphan Glasgow''' was baptised at Stevenston, Ayrshire, on 10 Aug 1718. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4170|James Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Auld-2246|Mary Auld]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Stevenston is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

Euphan Glasgow was one of the children recorded to James Glasgow and Mary Auld in the Stevenston register, alongside [[Glasgow-4111|Margaret]] (1717).

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-4170]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Euphan’s 1718 transcript names James and only maternal surname Auld, closely following Margaret’s 1717 James/Mary Auld entry in Stevenston. Same pair is strongly supported, without supplying the missing maternal forename literally.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; James is defined by the Stevenston Auld household; no certainty transfers to proposed Kilwinning ancestry.

Next useful test: Inspect original 1718 entry for the omitted maternal forename and household details.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0369064&tab=this Findmypast OPR615/1 transcript: Euphan, James Glasgow and Mary Auld, Stevenston, 10 August1718]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



The baptism is the only record found for Euphan Glasgow; it establishes her parents and baptism but gives no later life, marriage or death.
